name: csoai-gspc-mcp
description: Stdio MCP server for the live GSPC board, signed measurement cards, and public-root merkle at councilof.ai. Seven honest tools: board_totals, get_axis, verify_card (pinned-key, three-state), list_cards, get_root, get_card, verify_inclusion. We measure, never certify; unmeasured is first-class; verdicts are VALID / INVALID / UNCHECKABLE, never two-state. A 404 leaf is INVALID. Zero dependencies.
